methods.description: Find contracts conforming to `trait`. `trait` is required (server 400s without it).

methods.summary: Get one contract from the registry by id, or `null`.
methods.description:
Get one contract from the registry by id, or `null`.

`includeAbi` adds the full ABI; `includeSource` adds the Clarity source
it was deployed with. Neither needs a Stacks node. Resolves to `null` on
404.

types.name: ContractConformance
types.summary: Whether a trait match must be declared in source, inferred from ABI, or either.

types.name: ContractsEnvelope
types.summary: One page of contracts and the cursor for the next page.

types.name: ContractsListParams
types.summary: Trait, conformance, and paging for listing contracts.

fields.name: trait
fields.description: Required. Trait identifier to match (e.g. "sip-010", or a fully-qualified trait).

fields.name: include
fields.description: Set to "abi" to include the full ABI blob in each row.

fields.name: cursor
fields.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's `next_cursor`.

types.name: ContractSummary
types.summary: A deployed contract with its traits, standards, and ABI status.

fields.name: classified_at
fields.description: When the ABI was read and classified, or `null`.

fields.name: source
fields.description:
The Clarity source from the deploy transaction, present only with
`includeSource`. `null` when the deploy transaction is not indexed.
